{{short description|American statistician}}
'''Ida Irene Hess''' (August 27, 1910 – July 5, 2009) was an American statistician who was an expert on [[survey methodology]] for scientific surveys and who directed the [[University of Michigan Institute for Social Research]].{{r|anobit|record|sampler}}

==Life==
Hess was born on August 27, 1910, in [[Muhlenberg County, Kentucky]],{{r|anobit|record|sampler}} the daughter of a [[Central City, Kentucky|Central City]] [[Mining engineering|mining engineer]].{{r|anobit}} After three years of study at [[Evansville College]],{{r|details}} she completed her undergraduate studies in mathematics at [[Indiana University Bloomington]], graduating in 1931, and returned home to become a mathematics teacher at a junior high school in Central City.{{r|anobit|record|sampler}}

Beginning in 1940,{{r|anobit|details}} she used the time in her summers off from teaching to study statistics at the [[University of Michigan]].{{r|record|sampler}} Although she earned no degree from this study, her work there provided her with enough statistical experience to pass the [[civil service entrance examination]],
preparing her for wartime service in the U.S. [[Bureau of Labor Statistics]] and the [[National Institute of Standards and Technology|Bureau of Standards]], where she helped work on bomb fuses. After the war, she moved again, to the [[United States Census Bureau|Census Bureau]].{{r|details}}

She joined the Institute for Social Research in 1954, and later became its director when its founding director, [[Leslie Kish]], stepped down.{{r|anobit|record|sampler}} She faced mandatory retirement at age 70, in 1981,{{r|details}} but continued to be active in statistics and in the institute.{{r|details|record|sampler}}

In 1977, she became the founding chair of the Section on Survey Research Methods of the [[American Statistical Association]].{{r|details}}

She died on July 5, 2009.{{r|anobit|record|sampler}}

==Selected publications==
Along with many papers with Leslie Kish,
Hess is the author or co-author of:{{r|details}}
*''Probability Sampling of Hospitals and Patients'' (with Donald C. Reidel, and Thomas Fitzpatrick, 1961){{r|pshp}}
*''Sampling for Social Research Surveys'' (1995)
*''Controlled Selection Continued'' (with Steven G. Heeringa, 2002)
*''The Practice of Survey Research at the Survey Research Center, 1947–1980'' (2005)

==Awards and honors==
Hess became a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] in 1972.{{r|fasa}}
